title: Georgia Racing Hall of Fame

services.name: Museum Tickets
services.desc: The Georgia Racing Hall of Fame offers free admission to residents of Dawson County everyday during normal business hours with the presentation of a valid Driver’s License or proof of residence. Admission will be charged for all persons during special events regardless of residency. The Dawsonville Chamber of Commerce has partnered with the Georgia Racing Hall of Fame to help bring you everything you need to know while visiting Dawsonville. CLICK HERE to visit the Destination Dawsonville website. All programs and services are included with admission to the museum unless stated otherwise. Mobility Impairments - There is one main entrance and it is located on the main level of the street
